name: Aceclofenac + Thiocolchicoside
meta: Prescription-only fixed-dose combination. Components – Aceclofenac: Schedule H –
prescription only; Thiocolchicoside: Schedule H – prescription only
sections: Phenylacetic acid derivative (glycolic ester of diclofenac)
White crystalline powder, practically insoluble in water (BCS Class II).
Yellow crystalline powder, soluble in water.

Aceclofenac: A glycolic acid ester of diclofenac developed in Spain; widely used in Europe and India for osteoarthritis, RA and ankylosing spondylitis. First approval/introduction: Patented 1983; approved 1992 (Prodesfarma / Almirall, Spain). Thiocolchicoside: A semi-synthetic sulfur derivative of colchicoside (from Gloriosa superba). In 2013 the EMA restricted oral use to 7 days and IM to 5 days because a metabolite caused aneuploidy in vitro. First approval/introduction: Introduced in France in the 1950s–60s (Roussel).
Aceclofenac relieves inflammatory pain; thiocolchicoside reduces painful muscle contracture – breaking the pain–spasm cycle.

Aceclofenac Inhibits cyclo-oxygenase (preferential COX-2) reducing prostaglandin synthesis; also inhibits IL-1 and TNF and stimulates cartilage matrix synthesis. Analgesic, anti-inflammatory and antipyretic. Receptor / target profile: Inhibits COX (preferential COX-2) and suppresses IL-1beta and TNF; stimulates glycosaminoglycan synthesis in cartilage.

Thiocolchicoside Competitive GABA-A receptor antagonist and glycine-receptor modulator with myorelaxant action at supraspinal level; relieves painful muscle spasm. Receptor / target profile: Competitive GABA-A and glycine receptor antagonist; suspected nicotinic receptor antagonism.
Hepatic – CYP2C9 to 4'-hydroxyaceclofenac (main), small amounts of diclofenac
Summary: Rapid, complete absorption; Tmax 1.25–3 h. >99% protein bound. Metabolised to 4'-hydroxyaceclofenac and diclofenac (CYP2C9). Half-life ~4 h.
Hydrolysed to 3-demethylthiocolchicine (aglycone), then glucuronidated to active SL18.0740
Summary: Oral bioavailability ~25%; metabolised to active 3-demethylthiocolchicine glucuronide (SL18.0740). Half-life of active metabolite 3–5 h.
